Those avatars are against VRchat's terms of service, and are not supposed to be used in public instances. Report them if you see them. 

The kids are also not supposed to be here per the same TOS. Report them as well.

But keep in mind that regardless of the number of reports made, the problem will never truly go away. There's thousands of people in this game, and less than 100 VRchat employees.

That's why the rule is "no NSFW in publics" vs "no NSFW, period", it's because VRchat staff recognizes that trying to block NSFW content entirely is a fool's errand and it'd be better to label the avatars as NSFW so they can be hidden from new users by default. 

Same with kids, they're not supposed to be here but they can and will get in here regardless. Whatever barriers you put up, they'll find a way around it. Hence the recent push towards age verified instances. 

And yes, those two groups (NSFW and kids) being in the same room is a huge problem. However!

Manually moderating and approving avatars every single time would be extremely expensive for VRchat staff (having to hire/contract additional employees to handle that), frustrate avatar creators trying to upload new versions, and unfairly punish those who use NSFW avatars but only in private worlds (following the rules). Not to mention being a huge invasion of privacy.

I'm not terribly fond of NSFW avatars in public instances either, but this just isn't a practical solution for anyone.

My counterproposal would be an automated system that checks for certain tells, most notably the number of lights on an avatar (IYKYK), and flags the avatar for manual inspection. If it's NSFW, it's flagged as such and hidden from users by default.

details: All avatars that want to be uploaded should have to go through an inspection by a moderation member. I don't care how many avatars are uploaded or updated per day. I've seen 5 lewd avatars that can go naked and have e-sex in the past 10 minutes by just simply going into an avatar search world such as prismic's and clicking on show recently updated. It truly is disgusting to think that you guys are letting such avatars be used around not only adults who may not want to see that, but little kids.
title: We need better moderation teams and more at that.
